title: Da Lat in two days
summary: Lake and market on day one; cable car, Truc Lam, and Datanla or Lang Biang on day two.

stops.name: Xuan Huong Lake
stops.note: Morning walk before the market crowds.

stops.name: Da Lat Market
stops.note: Strawberries and avocado ice cream on the slope.

stops.name: Da Lat Railway Station
stops.note: Art-deco station; add the Trai Mat train if you want Linh Phuoc the same morning.

stops.name: Truc Lam Zen Monastery
stops.note: Cable car from Robin Hill when the sky is clear, then the monastery yards. Modest clothing.

stops.name: Datanla Falls
stops.note: Afternoon on Prenn Pass. Skip the coaster if you only wanted the falls.

stops.name: Da Lat Night Market
stops.note: Grilled rice paper after dark; the night stalls sit near the day market.

seoDescription: A two-day Da Lat plan: lake and market, then cable car, Truc Lam, and Datanla Falls.
